C0968.title: Reselling Order-Grabbing Software to Didi Drivers Case
keywords: illegally obtaining computer information system data
C0968.summary: Starting January 2024, three individuals including Liu purchased plug-in order-grabbing programs such as 'Flash Man' and 'Violent Rabbit' online and resold them to Didi drivers. The software was used for automated order snatching to generate profit, with fees charged per transaction or per day.
